sources.notes: Disease concepts. Large OWL; import a pinned subset or the OBO JSON edition, not the OWL, if size matters.

sources.name: Uberon anatomy ontology
conditions: record release tag and file sha256
sources.notes: Tissue and organ context for PARALLAX comparability.

sources.name: Cell Ontology
conditions: record release tag and file sha256

sources.name: Gene Ontology
sources.notes: 'current' is a moving pointer; pin a dated release from the GO release archive before import.

sources.name: Evidence and Conclusion Ontology
sources.verification: verified (CC0 statement in the file header and repository LICENSE)
conditions: none required; attribution still good practice

sources.name: NCBI organismal classification
sources.notes: Species for study models and microbiome taxa. Not in the namespace registry yet.

sources.name: Chemical Entities of Biological Interest
sources.notes: Metabolites such as butyrate. About 896 MB; import a subset of the terms the graph actually references.

sources.name: Human Phenotype Ontology
sources.licence: HPO custom licence (not an open Creative Commons licence)
sources.verification: verified (page returned 404 status with content; re-read)
conditions: acknowledge and cite the HPO Consortium
show dates or version numbers wherever HPO files are shown publicly
content and logical relationships must not be altered; changes go through the HPO issue tracker
add the required 'uses the Human Phenotype Ontology (version)' statement
sources.notes: Use is allowed but a published subset or remapped hierarchy could count as altering content. Needs your decision on whether subsetting is acceptable before import.

sources.name: HGNC gene nomenclature
sources.notes: Already an identifier namespace. Licence not read here; do not assume.

sources.name: UniProt Knowledgebase
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (copyrightable parts); cross-references can carry their own terms
sources.notes: Used for protein identifiers and lookups already.

sources.name: ChEMBL
sources.notes: Registered as a stub with no live fetch.

sources.name: LOINC
sources.licence: not verified in this audit (own licence)
conditions: clinical vocabulary; belongs to the clinical products, not the research graph
sources.notes: hsi-core carries no clinical or patient data.

sources.name: SNOMED CT
sources.licence: SNOMED International affiliate licence; UK edition through NHS TRUD
conditions: licence required; derivatives and cross-maps are covered by the licence
clinical use sits with the clinical products
sources.notes: Not an open ontology. Do not import into the research graph.

sources.name: WHO ICD classifications
sources.licence: CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO for WHO classifications (no adaptation of the codes)
sources.notes: The no-derivatives term conflicts with remapping codes into a graph. Use Mondo for disease concepts instead.

conditions: read NLM terms before any use
